This sample is part of the "PPG
MULTISAMPLE 004 Digital Shorty" sample pack. It is a very short sound
effect with some pitch element in it, and can be used for arpeggios. In
the sample pack there are 16 samples evenly spread across 5 octaves (C1
till C6). The note in the sample name (C, E or G#) does not indicate
the pitch of the sound but the key on my keyboard. The sound was
created on the PPG VSTi. After that normalising and fades where applied within Cubase SX.
